hook: A satellite-altimetry foundation model forecasts ocean eddy centers 15 days ahead to within 25.2 km.
summary: HaiRuo, a 1.05-billion-parameter model pretrained on 24 years of altimetry, forecasts sea level, velocity and eddy tracks from 30 days of maps. It cuts 15-day centre error 18% against fourteen other methods. Evaluation uses eddies identified from altimetry itself, so it measures agreement with that product, not independent ocean observations.
title: HaiRuo: Forecasting Ocean Eddies as Fields and Objects with a Satellite-Altimetry Foundation Model
